risks.title: Sensitivity to Economic Cycles and Real Estate Markets
risks.score_rationale: The risk is positioned first in the 10-K with strong language (material adverse effect). It concerns the majority of the company's sales linked to construction and remodeling, sectors highly sensitive to interest rates and inflation. The Macro category is heavily weighted during periods of economic tensions.
risks.summary: A recession or prolonged elevated interest rates could significantly reduce demand for the company's products.

risks.title: International Competition and Downward Price Pressure
risks.score_rationale: The factor is described as a major risk with mention of dumping, foreign subsidies and competitive innovation. The language is repeated and emphasized, indicating a structural threat. The Competition category is critical in a mature industry.
risks.summary: The company faces intense competition that may force price decreases and loss of market share.

risks.title: Risks Related to Russian Operations
risks.score_rationale: The Russia risk is detailed across multiple paragraphs, with mention of sanctions, foreign exchange restrictions, expropriation risks and significant cash blockage. The language is alarming and specific. The Geopolitical category is currently highly weighted.
risks.summary: Operations in Russia expose the company to sanctions, cash repatriation difficulties and expropriation risks.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Rate Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: 46% of sales are international, with significant exposure to translation of results. The risk is repeated in multiple sections with moderate but consistent language. The Macro category is systemic.
risks.summary: Currency variations can significantly impact consolidated results and period-to-period comparability.

risks.title: Difficulty Anticipating Consumer Preferences
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly linked to innovation and rapid trends in the flooring sector. Mention of rapid changes and material impact. The Industrial category is central to product strategy.
risks.summary: Rapid evolution of consumer tastes requires continuous innovation to maintain market position and competitiveness.

_validation: Dataset validation summary: 1) Sector corrected from 'Information Technology' to 'Consumer Discretionary' (flooring is consumer discretionary, not IT). 2) Tagline translated to English from French. 3) hero_kpi_rationale improved to be more specific and removed em-dashes. 4) Net Sales: value converted from 10.8 (billions assumed) to 10785.4 (millions in source), yoy calculated as -0.5%, history shortened to 3 actual years. 5) Global Ceramic Sales: value converted to 4289.4M, yoy calculated as 1.5%, history limited to 2 data points. 6) Flooring NA Sales: value converted to 3672.3M, yoy calculated as -5.8%, history limited to actual data. 7) Flooring ROW Sales: value converted to 2823.7M, yoy calculated as -2.9%, history limited to actual data. 8) Operating Margin corrected from 10.3% to actual 4.5% (operating income 489.8 / net sales 10785.4), yoy is -29.7%. 9) Net Earnings yoy calculated as -28.1% (369.9 vs 514.7). 10) Capital Expenditures yoy calculated as -30.2% from disclosed comparable data. 11) Stories_kpis restructured: separated cumulative restructuring (365M) from new initiative savings (30M), changed story categories to 'Operational Excellence', improved descriptions to match source language. 12) Risks section corrected: sector risk category name changed for clarity, all risks re-evaluated based on source prominence. All KPI values now verified against consolidated financial statements and MD&A.

company_description: Mohawk Industries, Inc. designs, manufactures, sources, distributes, and markets flooring products for residential and commercial remodeling, and new construction channels in the United States, Europe, Latin America, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Global Ceramic, Flooring North America, and Flooring Rest of the World. The company provides ceramic, porcelain, and natural stone tiles products for floor and wall applications; natural stones, porcelain slabs, and quartz countertops, as well as installation materials; floor covering products comprising broadloom carpets, carpet tiles, rugs and mats, carpet pads, laminates, medium-density fiberboards, wood floorings, vinyl tiles, hybrid flooring, and sheet vinyl; and roofing panels, insulation boards, mezzanine flooring products, medium-density fiberboard, decorative panels, and chipboards. It also licenses its intellectual property to flooring manufacturers. The company sells its products under the American Olean, Daltile, Decortiles, Durkan, Eliane, Elizabeth, Feltex, Godfrey Hirst, IVC Home, Karastan, Kerama Marazzi, Marazzi, Moduleo, Mohawk, Pergo, Quick-Step, Unilin, Vitromex, GH Commercial, Hycraft, Lentex Flooring, Leoline, Redbook, EmilGroup, KAI, Ragno, Aladdin Commercial, Durkan, Foss, IVC Resilient Design, Mohawk Group,  Mohawk Home, and Portico. It offers its products to home centers, company-owned service centers and stores, floor covering retailers, ceramic tile specialists, e-commerce retailers, residential builders, independent distributors, commercial contractors, and commercial end users. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Calhoun, Georgia.

fr.activity: Mohawk Industries, Inc. est une entreprise de fabrication de sols spécialisée dans la création de produits pour améliorer les espaces résidentiels et commerciaux à l'échelle mondiale.
fr.products: Les principaux produits de Mohawk Industries incluent les sols en vinyle, les sols en linoléum et les sols en bois.
fr.customers: Les principaux clients de Mohawk Industries sont les architectes, les designers d'intérieur et les propriétaires de maisons qui cherchent à améliorer leurs espaces.
fr.edge: Mohawk Industries se démarque par sa capacité à créer des produits durables et de haute qualité qui répondent aux besoins des clients.

en.activity: Mohawk Industries, Inc. is a flooring manufacturer dedicated to creating products that enhance residential and commercial spaces worldwide.
en.products: Mohawk Industries' main products include vinyl flooring, linoleum flooring and hardwood flooring.
en.customers: Mohawk Industries' main customers are architects, interior designers and homeowners seeking to improve their spaces.
en.edge: Mohawk Industries stands out for its ability to create durable and high-quality products that meet customer needs.

de.activity: Mohawk Industries, Inc. ist ein Unternehmen für Bodenbeläge, das sich auf die Entwicklung von Produkten für die Verbesserung von Wohn- und Geschäftsräumen weltweit konzentriert.
de.products: Die wichtigsten Produkte von Mohawk Industries umfassen Vinylbodenbeläge, Linoleumbodenbeläge und Holzbodenbeläge.
de.customers: Die wichtigsten Kunden von Mohawk Industries sind Architekten, Innenarchitekten und Haushaltsbesitzer, die ihre Räume verbessern möchten.
de.edge: Mohawk Industries unterscheidet sich durch seine Fähigkeit, nachhaltige und hochwertige Produkte zu entwickeln, die den Bedürfnissen der Kunden entsprechen.

fr.positioning: Mohawk Industries est un leader dans la fabrication de sols en vinyle et en linoléum, avec une part de marché significative dans le secteur.
fr.tech_products: Les produits clés de Mohawk Industries incluent le système de sol en vinyle DuPont Corian et le système de sol en linoléum Marmoleum.
fr.moat: Mohawk Industries dispose d'un avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à sa capacité à développer des produits innovants et à son réseau de distribution captive.
fr.risks: Un risque potentiel pour Mohawk Industries est la concurrence de grandes entreprises de construction de maisons, qui peuvent offrir des prix compétitifs et des produits similaires.

en.positioning: Mohawk Industries is a leader in the manufacture of vinyl and linoleum flooring, with a significant market share in the sector.
en.tech_products: Mohawk Industries' key products include the DuPont Corian vinyl flooring system and the Marmoleum linoleum flooring system.
en.moat: Mohawk Industries has a durable competitive advantage due to its ability to develop innovative products and its captive distribution network.
en.risks: A potential risk for Mohawk Industries is competition from large homebuilders, which can offer competitive prices and similar products.
